description: Illuminate any task with Rothco’s G.I.Type D-Cell Flashlights. Crafted for reliability and versatility, these flashlights are essential for any adventure or emergency. Featuring an angle flashlight design, they boast a multi-mode switch with a signal button for Morse code communication. Constructed from high-impact plastic, they're lightweight and waterproof, ensuring durability in various conditions. These flashlights come equipped with four filter lenses in red, blue, yellow, or green, conveniently stored in the bottom. Plus, with a spare bulb located under the battery spring, you'll never be left in the dark. The metal ring on the bottom allows for easy attachment to other gear, while the metal belt clip ensures secure fastening to your belt. Whether you're adding to your active-duty gear collection or preparing a bug-out bag, Rothco’s Service Type D-Cell Flashlights are a must-have for any situation. Trust in Rothco for reliable light when you need it most.
